title: The full-length shows from 1927 to Jazz Train
summary: He began writing full shows in 1927, 'Desires of 1927' and 'Brown Skin Models', ending with Jazz Train in Paris, London and Windsor Castle.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Among the full length shows that he's written, in answer to that question he said, "I began writing full shows in 1927. My first one was a Harlem version of the Zeigfield Follies called 'Desires of 1927.' The next year I wrote, 'Brown Skin Models,' it was moved downtown to Broadway. I wrote through the years, ending up with 'Jazz Train.' We did that show in Europe and it was a Standing Room Only hit in Paris and London."
And then, of course, he talked about the command performance at Windsor Castle before royalty. And I think we have that on the tape in other places.
